Sam (People Ops): FYI: quick all-hands Wed 9am PT (HQ + Zoom). Short agenda below. Please add Qs here or use the anon form: https://forms.redwood.internal/allhands-qna (closes Tue 5pm).

Sam (People Ops): Agenda (20m):
• 7m — Exec snapshot & priorities (Zoe)
• 5m — Playbook launch highlights + checklist (Priya)
• 4m — Runtime perf update & canary plan (Yamir)
• 2m — Security note: small retention tweak (Marcus)
• 2m — GTM partner mention & renewals heads-up (Lena)
• 0-?m — Rapid Q&A (may run long)

Sam (People Ops): Two asks: 1) Upload slides to drive.redwood.internal/allhands/wed-9am by Tue 3pm. 2) If you need demo infra, list it here.

Zoe (CEO): I'll open with runway + one leadership ask: flag cross-team blockers. Keep it tight.

Priya (Product): We'll show the playbook checklist and success metrics. Requesting a 2-slide slot; will post the link during the call.

Yamir (Eng): Eng wants to demo KV-prefetch perf gain (~12% p99). Needs co-host to share screen. Low-risk clip.

Marcus (Security): Heads-up: proposing internal logs retention change from 90d->45d for debug buckets to reduce storage costs. No customer-facing default changes; I'll scope during my slot.

Lena (Sales): We'll mention the partner integration for 20s and ask RevOps for a renewals FAQ.

Sam (People Ops): Recording will be posted to #all-hands-recordings within 24h. If you want clips, DM me timestamps after the call.

Calendar Bot: Event updated: "All-Hands — Playbook Brief & Ops" Wed 09:00 PT — Zoom link pinned.

Sam (People Ops): Please confirm slide upload here once done. Thanks! :sparkles:
